amendment.nonsemantic_change: Documentation may clarify meaning only when canonical policy bytes and SHA-256 remain unchanged.
amendment.prospective_reset: Every semantic policy, feature, prompt, model-config, clock, threshold, baseline, partition, expression, risk, or exit change creates a new policy identity and restarts prospective evidence.
amendment.semantic_change: A semantic change requires a new policy version, new canonical bytes and digest, independent review, and a fresh untouched/prospective gate; observed outcomes cannot silently amend V1.

baselines.rule: Emit UNCERTAIN for every otherwise eligible event and retain zero signed return in the common denominator.
Emit the sign of the candidate's frozen deterministic confirmation only when all confirmation thresholds pass; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
Invert a valid PRICE_CONTINUATION direction and retain its abstentions.

Earnings uses equal trinary votes for EPS surprise, revenue surprise and guidance: sum at least two is UP, at most minus two is DOWN, else UNCERTAIN. Macro uses the frozen cohort component mapping, trinary threshold plus or minus 0.5 z, at least two available votes, and absolute vote sum at least two; hot or hawkish maps DOWN and cool or dovish maps UP. The same deterministic confirmation may only veto.
Use the strict reasoner output and deterministic validation/confirmation defined by this policy.
Run the same bounded reasoner route with only the frozen structured numeric feature records and data-health facts; retain identical clocks and gates.
Invert only a final directional BOUNDED_LLM output and retain every BOUNDED_LLM abstention; never enter the permit path.
Create 256 deterministic UP or DOWN controls from SHA-256(policy_sha256,event_id,counter_000_to_255), matched to BOUNDED_LLM directional coverage and abstentions; never enter the permit path.

clocks.event_rule: Official results publication is proven before the reaction session open; a calendar label alone is insufficient.
clocks.reaction_session_rule: Same eligible full regular session as the scheduled earnings date.
clocks.universe_freeze: 16:15:00 on the immediately preceding eligible regular session

clocks.event_rule: Official results publication is proven at or after the prior session close and before the next eligible session open.
clocks.reaction_session_rule: Next eligible full regular session after the official results publication.
clocks.universe_freeze: 16:15:00 on the immediately preceding eligible regular session

confirmation.method: Use eligible continuous-session observations only. Fit r_stock=alpha+beta_market*r_SPY+beta_sector*(r_sector-r_SPY) by OLS with intercept on split-adjusted price-only daily log returns over 252 sessions ending 21 sessions before the reaction session, with no winsorization or forward fill. Apply the same factor formula to synchronized 09:30-09:35 log returns.
confirmation.veto_rule: For LLM UP, CONTINUE requires residual at least +0.0025. For LLM DOWN, CONTINUE requires residual at most -0.0025. Opposite residual beyond the threshold is REVERSE; absolute residual below threshold is NONE; LLM UNCERTAIN is NOT_APPLICABLE. Only CONTINUE preserves direction. The validator may never reverse a direction or create one from UNCERTAIN.

rules: Every material fact and feature is dependency-closed to evidence public at or before the candidate decision cutoff.
Publisher time, retrieval time, source-observed time, hash representation, entitlement and redistribution status remain distinct.
SEC acceptance time never substitutes for public publication time.
Consensus and news may be UNAVAILABLE but are never inferred or backfilled.
UP or DOWN requires at least one primary issuer or SEC citation and one market-feature citation.
Missing, late, conflicting, unsupported or rights-unclear required evidence fails before a reasoner call.

features.definition: (actual diluted EPS - frozen consensus EPS) / max(abs(frozen consensus EPS), 0.01 USD/share); point-in-time licensed consensus only.
(actual revenue - frozen consensus revenue) / abs(frozen consensus revenue), requiring a positive denominator and point-in-time licensed consensus.
Current seasonal EPS difference EPS_t-EPS_t-4 divided by the sample standard deviation of the prior eight quarterly seasonal differences, using only point-in-time statements.
(revenue_t-revenue_t-4)/abs(revenue_t-4), requiring a positive prior-year denominator.
Deterministic comparison of newly published issuer guidance with the immediately prior issuer guidance for the same period; NOT_GIVEN is a present value, not imputation.
Prior regular-session close to first eligible post-auction continuous observation, residualized with the frozen SPY and sector-excess beta model.
Issuer 09:30-09:35 log return minus beta_market times SPY return minus beta_sector times sector-minus-SPY return over synchronized eligible continuous-session observations.
Current 09:30-09:35 consolidated volume divided by the median identical-window volume over the preceding 20 full sessions, requiring at least 15 valid sessions.
Median valid SIP NBBO spread ((ask-bid)/mid)*10000 over the 60 seconds ending at the observation-window close, requiring at least 30 valid quote samples.
Maximum age of required issuer, SPY and sector quote observations at the feature snapshot.
Sample standard deviation of exactly 20 issuer daily log returns through D-1 multiplied by sqrt(252).
Sum of daily factor-residual log returns for the 20 sessions through D-1 using the frozen beta coefficients.
(eligible issuer end price / issuer VWAP over 09:30-09:35 - 1)*10000, requiring positive price and VWAP.

candidates.hypothesis: A coherent post-earnings interpretation whose issuer-specific opening reaction confirms the same direction may continue over a later frozen underlying-return horizon; the null is no after-cost incremental value beyond price-only and deterministic-parser controls.

universe.candidate_retention: Retain every considered issuer/event, every exclusion and reason, every eligible event, every abstention and every later failure. No result-dependent deletion or discretionary ticker insertion.
universe.ranking: For capacity only: descending frozen 20-session median dollar volume, then ticker ASCII ascending, then event_id ASCII ascending. Ranking never changes denominator membership.

evidence_backed: Systematic post-earnings residual continuation in liquid US common stocks is the accepted primary research candidate.
Universe and event timing are frozen point-in-time with no discretionary insertion.
BMO and AMC remain separate in clocks, policy and reporting.
The LLM emits only UP, DOWN or UNCERTAIN and deterministic confirmation may only veto.
Direction is evaluated on the underlying before any expression promotion.
owner_selected: The 16:15 universe freeze, price and liquidity floors, exact 09:30-09:35 observation clock and decision deadlines are preregistered V1 design choices, not observed alpha.
The beta estimator, sector map, 0.0025 confirmation threshold, feature definitions, partitions and sample floors are conservative V1 design choices made before outcome inspection.
Every owner-selected value is a falsifiable hypothesis and cannot support a profitability claim by itself.

clocks.event_rule: Use the exact official BLS schedule and public-observability timestamp; the normal scheduled time is 10:00 ET but it is never inferred.
clocks.reaction_session_rule: The release must occur during a full eligible regular SPY session; anchor uses valid SPY SIP NBBO midpoint observations from 09:55:00 inclusive to 10:00:00 exclusive.
clocks.universe_freeze: 16:15:00 on the immediately preceding full regular session

clocks.event_rule: Use the exact official BLS schedule and public-observability timestamp; the normal scheduled time is 08:30 ET but it is never inferred.
clocks.reaction_session_rule: Interpretation may occur before the open, but confirmation uses only eligible regular-session SPY observations; no premarket or extended-hours price enters the policy.
clocks.universe_freeze: 16:15:00 on the immediately preceding full regular session

confirmation.method: For each release cohort separately compute r_event=log(P_end/P_anchor), the median same-clock return over the preceding 60 full non-event sessions, and scale=max(1.4826*MAD,0.0005). z=(r_event-median)/scale. Confirmation also requires same-window volume ratio and the end midpoint on the matching side of event-window VWAP.
confirmation.veto_rule: CONTINUE requires LLM UP with z at least +1.0 or LLM DOWN with z at most -1.0, volume ratio at least 1.25, and end midpoint beyond event-window VWAP in the same direction. An eligible opposite z is REVERSE; a failed magnitude, volume or VWAP gate is NONE; LLM UNCERTAIN is NOT_APPLICABLE. Only CONTINUE preserves direction.

rules: JOLTS and Employment Situation use separate official field maps, clocks, normalization histories, partitions and reports.
The official release bytes, publication/receipt clocks, required actual/prior/revision fields and hashes are frozen before interpretation.
Consensus is optional and never invented; without a timestamped permitted source the packet says UNAVAILABLE and makes no surprise claim.
Every market observation becomes usable only at its source timestamp; no same-bar or premarket fantasy observation is allowed.
UP or DOWN requires at least one official BLS citation, one reaction-snapshot citation and a strongest falsifier.
Missing, late, conflicting, unsupported or rights-unclear required evidence fails before a reasoner call.

features.definition: Official JOLTS job-openings actual, prior and published revision record with source-level timestamps.
Official JOLTS hires actual, prior and published revision record with source-level timestamps.
Official JOLTS quits actual, prior and published revision record with source-level timestamps.
Official JOLTS layoffs-and-discharges actual, prior and published revision record with source-level timestamps.
Official JOLTS total-separations actual, prior and published revision record with source-level timestamps.
Official Employment Situation nonfarm-payroll change with prior and published revisions.
Official Employment Situation unemployment rate with prior and revision metadata.
Official Employment Situation average-hourly-earnings month-over-month change with prior and revision metadata.
Official Employment Situation labor-force participation rate with prior and revision metadata.
Point-in-time standardized component surprises from a permitted consensus source; unavailable components remain explicit and no expectation is inferred.
Every officially published old-to-new component revision, with no headline-only netting; required when the official report publishes revisions.
Same-clock SPY event log return from the cohort anchor to the window end using valid regular-session SIP NBBO midpoints.
Robust same-cohort same-clock z-score over prior 60 full non-event sessions with at least 45 observations and a 0.0005 log-return scale floor.
SPY event-window volume divided by median identical-window volume over prior 20 full sessions, requiring at least 15 observations.
(SPY end midpoint / event-window SPY VWAP - 1)*10000.
SPY event-window high-low range divided by event-window VWAP times 10000.
Signed maximum adverse movement from the event-window directional extreme to the end midpoint, in basis points.
Median valid SPY SIP NBBO spread ((ask-bid)/mid)*10000 over the 60 seconds ending at the observation-window close.
Age of the SPY quote observation used at the feature snapshot.
Sample standard deviation of exactly 20 SPY daily log returns through D-1 multiplied by sqrt(252).

candidates.hypothesis: A materially one-sided official macro interpretation whose same-cohort SPY price, volume and VWAP confirmation agrees may continue over a later frozen underlying-return horizon; the null is no after-cost incremental value beyond price-only and deterministic-parser controls.

universe.candidate_retention: Retain every scheduled supported release, exclusion, ineligible event, abstention and later failure. A late release may be excluded but can never be replaced by a discretionary event.
universe.ranking: No cross-family ranking. Evaluate every frozen event; BLS_JOLTS and BLS_EMPLOYMENT_SITUATION remain separate.

evidence_backed: Scheduled macro-release SPY continuation is the accepted challenger and not approved alpha.
BLS JOLTS and Employment Situation are the accepted first release families and require official point-in-time fields and revisions.
SPY-only, post-release, no anticipatory position, separate release clocks, optional non-invented consensus and deterministic price confirmation are inherited research boundaries.
Options cannot act before the regular session and the LLM cannot choose or execute an instrument.
owner_selected: The exact regular-session windows, 60-second schedule tolerance, robust z-score, 0.0005 scale floor, 1.0 z threshold, 1.25 volume ratio and VWAP gate are preregistered V1 hypotheses, not observed evidence.
The component mappings, entry/exit research grids, partitions and sample floors are owner-selected before outcome inspection.
Aegis premarket price inputs were intentionally rejected because the current repository evidence contract permits only registered regular-session observations.

separation_rules: Underlying directional evidence, expression economics, conservative quote-side shadow PnL, broker PAPER observations and profitability claims are separate truth surfaces.
A Q-FAST NOT_REJECTED_SMALL_SAMPLE result remains NOT_ALPHA_EVIDENCE.
A PAPER lifecycle can support PAPER_OPERATIONAL_RESULT only and cannot prove alpha or execution quality.
Every candidate, exclusion, abstention, source failure, veto, no-expression, risk rejection and lifecycle ambiguity remains visible in its declared denominator.

legacy_infrastructure.debit_vertical_bridge: The existing research-to-permit bridge accepts debit-vertical package data as an inert compatibility surface. It is not the output of this strategy policy and cannot prove Gate D promotion.
legacy_infrastructure.fixed_60_minute_hold: The existing demonstration and synthetic evaluator contain a 60-minute fill-relative hold. V1 does not freeze it as a research winner or production exit.
legacy_infrastructure.rule: Legacy candidate_signal, package, permit, quantity, price, 60-minute hold and 500 USD constants remain supplied synthetic or infrastructure inputs. They cannot enter a V1 generated strategy decision or authorize PAPER mutation.

citation_requirements: Every evidence ID must exist in the exact immutable packet.
UP or DOWN requires at least one candidate-primary-source citation and one confirmation-market citation.
UP or DOWN requires a non-null strongest falsifier citing supplied evidence.

Evidence IDs are unique, maximum 16; contradictions maximum 8 with each summary maximum 400 Unicode code points; unknown codes maximum 16; top-level summary maximum 800 Unicode code points; strongest-falsifier summary maximum 400 Unicode code points.

output_fields.rule: Unique supplied evidence IDs only; directional decisions require primary and market classes.
Array of at most eight objects with exactly two supplied evidence_ids and one summary of at most 400 Unicode code points.
Unique codes from the tolerated or critical frozen unknown-code sets only.
Object with supplied evidence_id and summary of at most 400 Unicode code points for UP or DOWN; null only for UNCERTAIN.
Evidence-bounded rationale no longer than 800 Unicode code points.
